draw_3d_cubes: create a function that draws multiple 3D cubes at given positions with customizable size and color
draw_3d_spheres: build a module to render spheres at numpy array positions with configurable resolution and color
draw_3d_lines: create a function that draws 3D lines between start and end positions with a specified color
draw_skeleton: build a module to render a skeleton visualization using bone positions and cylinder primitives
draw_3d_text: create a function that projects 3D world positions to screen space and renders text labels
